about: The rules every new subject pack meets, per chapter. ONE file, read by tools/validate.py + tools/pack_quality.py (skill make_pack.py, tools/build.py) and copied into engine/packcheck.js RULES / QUALITY (app, Gemini generator, connector); tests/pack_rules.js checks the copies agree and that both checkers give the same issues. 'rules': the quantity rules of packs with subject.authoring.minPerKind (Gemini generator). 'quality': the full rules of packs with subject.authoring.rules >= 2 (docs/PIPELINES.md §4, tools/CONTENT_SPEC.md).
notes: A value under 'features' is required when the subject has that feature (subject.features.code / .math) or, for 'pictures', when the chapter has a picture (a figure block or a picture exercise): pictures only where they teach (docs/VISUAL.md §5), never to meet a count. A chapter that uses an optional value anyway needs the minimum too.
subject.authoring.minPerKind overrides every 'min' (start_subject.py writes 3). 0 turns the rules off: only for packs made before 2026-10-21.
Chapters of an older pack being extended (skill unpack.py) get warnings, new chapters errors.

checks.what: the chapter has its knowledge map (map/chNN.json → chapter.map)
points and learnables are well formed: unique ids, known levels and categories, every kp / with id exists
every knowledge point is in a learnable, or names the earlier DAG node that taught it (taughtIn)
every exercise type, focus tag and paradigm is in fits, or has a reason in unfit
every type in fits.types
every focus tag in fits.focus
every paradigm in fits.modes
difficulty 1/2/3 = 20/25/55 % of the chapter
recall <= 25 %, apply or higher >= 40 %, critical thinking (analyze/evaluate/create) >= 3 exercises
inside a section, easier exercises come first
every exercise names its learnable (lr), its kind of thinking (think) and, if any, a known paradigm (mode)
every learnable has >= 2 versions in >= 2 exercise types
every knowledge point with a category has >= 2 exercises in >= 2 types
every question of the sources (map.sourceQuestions) has an answer and an exercise that cites it (cite.sq)
every exercise keeps where it comes from in cite {src, loc} (metadata, never in the text)
no exercise, card or theory text points at the source's structure (question numbers, pages, paragraphs, 'the source says')
the explanation says why the answer is right and why the tempting wrong one is wrong (>= 2 sentences, >= 80 characters)
every mcq / odd option has its why
the right option is not written in the question
the right option is not by far the longest
the second-pass review (review/chNN.json → chapter.review): rubric on >= 15 learnables (or all), every exercise solved blind, every mismatch fixed

notes: Strictness: subject.authoring.rules >= 2 turns these checks on (start_subject.py writes 2). Errors when subject.authoring.by is 'claude' or 'gemini', warnings when it is 'learner' or 'import'. Packs without authoring.rules are not checked (made before 2026-10-21; TD-11).

The connector (noema_finish_upload, noema_save_pack) refuses a pack built since 'since' (pack.builtAt, or no builtAt at all) that has no subject.authoring.rules >= 2, so a pack cannot skip the checks by leaving the field out. Older packs keep working unchanged.

autoUnfit: a value that cannot fit the chapter needs no reason in unfit — the code types without subject.features.code, calc without .math, picture types when the chapter has no picture (pictures only where they teach, docs/VISUAL.md §5).
Counts are never checked: about 2 versions per learnable is the core set; there is no upper limit (docs/PIPELINES.md §4, a mild suggestion only).
